title: Sparstolonin B suppresses free fatty acid palmitate-induced chondrocyte inflammation and mitigates post-traumatic arthritis in obese mice.
authors: Ma, Haiwei; Xie, Chenglong; He, Gaolu; Chen, Zhengtai; Lu, Hongwei; Wu, Hongqiang; Cai, Hancheng; Dai, Zihan; Li, Baolong; Xu, Cong; Xue, Enxing
journal: Journal of cellular and molecular medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药Ssn B抑制游离脂肪酸诱导的软骨细胞炎症及肥胖小鼠骨关节炎，涉及TLR4/MD-2复合物分子对接，但核心是炎症信号通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Abnormal lipid metabolism, such as systemic increased free fatty acid, results in overproduction of pro-inflammatory enzymes and cytokines, which is crucial in the development of obesity-related osteoarthritis (OA). However, there are only a few drugs that target the lipotoxicity of OA. Recent researches have documented that the traditional Chinese medicine, Sparstolonin B (Ssn B), exerted anti-inflammatory effects in various diseases, but not yet in OA. On the basis of this evidence, our works purposed to evaluate the effect of Ssn B on free fatty acid (FFA) palmitate (PA)-stimulated human osteoarthritic chondrocytes and obesity-associated mouse OA model. We found that Ssn B suppressed PA-triggered inflammatory response and extracellular matrix catabolism in a concentration-dependent approach. In vivo, Ssn B treatment inhibited cartilage degeneration and subchondral bone calcification caused by joint mechanical imbalance and alleviated metabolic inflammation in obesity. Mechanistically, co-immunoprecipitine and molecular docking analysis showed that the formation of toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4)/myeloid differentiation protein-2 (MD-2) complex caused by PA was blocked by Ssn B. Subsequently, it leads to inactivation of PA-caused myeloid differentiation factor 88 (MyD88)-dependent nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) cascade. Together, these findings demonstrated that Ssn B is a potential treatment agent for joint degenerative diseases in obese individuals.
abstract_zh: 异常脂质代谢，如系统性游离脂肪酸增加，导致促炎酶和细胞因子的过度产生，这在肥胖相关骨关节炎（OA）的发展中至关重要。然而，针对OA脂毒性的药物寥寥无几。近期研究表明，中药Sparstolonin B（Ssn B）在多种疾病中发挥抗炎作用，但在OA中尚未见报道。基于此证据，我们的工作旨在评估Ssn B对游离脂肪酸（FFA）棕榈酸酯（PA）刺激的人骨关节炎软骨细胞及肥胖相关小鼠OA模型的影响。我们发现，Ssn B以浓度依赖性方式抑制了PA触发的炎症反应和细胞外基质分解代谢。在体内，Ssn B治疗抑制了由关节机械失衡引起的软骨退变和软骨下骨钙化，并减轻了肥胖中的代谢性炎症。机制上，免疫共沉淀和分子对接分析显示，PA引起的Toll样受体4（TLR4）/髓样分化蛋白-2（MD-2）复合物形成被Ssn B阻断。随后，这导致PA引起的髓样分化因子88（MyD88）依赖性核因子-κB（NF-κB）级联失活。综合这些发现表明，Ssn B是治疗肥胖个体关节退行性疾病的潜在药物。
